scope.runtime: Exact hashed Windows files from the local Steam installation and the frozen development candidate, separate hidden desktop and private offline profile for each process.
scope.timing: Each process used the same order after verified startup. Visit 1 is the first visit to that mode in that process with shared resources from earlier visits.
scope.input: The probe drove production menu and introduction controls through their signals, selected an existing unit through the game API, and sent the production battle input handler a right-click event. Draw timing included the display of its move effect. Human reading and input delays were excluded.
scope.render: Vulkan Forward+, 1280x720, VSYNC disabled, 60 FPS cap. The longest draw gap is between the click and battle first frame, including the clicks' partial first interval.
